title: Images and long text through pretrained embeddings
request: Let DCLab use images and long documents as inputs: an encoder turns each into a vector, cached by content, then a tabular model reads the vectors, with splits by source and near copies found.
spec: Images and long text turned into features by a pretrained encoder run locally and cached; splits by scene, document source or author; checks for near-duplicate images or texts across the split. Done when an image replica (synthetic shapes with a planted label) and a text replica are solved with the embeddings cached by content hash, and near-duplicates across folds are found.
plan: Keep the encoder injected; dclab_core owns the cache, the near-copy check and the grouped evaluation.
Provide local baselines that need no download, named as baselines in every record.
Load a pretrained image encoder only from weights the owner places; never download.
Plant near copies in the replicas (shots of a scene, texts pasted again) and find them.
Review, fix, and show each test fails on the fault it guards.

decisions.decision: No text encoder goes through the gateway's embedding purpose.
decisions.why: That purpose may see only the evidence records, never a workspace's texts; reading user texts needs a purpose of its own, which is the owner's decision.

decisions.decision: The near-copy threshold is calibrated per encoder from items against slightly changed copies, three quarters of the way to the copies.
decisions.why: A fixed 0.99 flagged different scenes with the same shape, and a midpoint flagged a text that was not a copy.

decisions.decision: The pretrained gap is a decision that fails, so the matrix lists it as missing.
decisions.why: A check that the encoder is a baseline passed by construction and hid the open item.

decisions.decision: The cache keys arrays and images by their values and files by their bytes, and refuses anything else.
decisions.why: A printed form keyed a PIL image by its memory address: 18 of 20 different images were served another image's vector.

change: dclab_core/embeddings.py, dclab_core/replicas/shapes_and_notes.py, dclab_rnd/encoders.py, dclab_rnd/kinds/embedded.py, tests/test_core_embeddings.py, tests/test_kind_matrix.py and tests/test_kinds.py (the 'Not built' example moved to scene graphs), dclab_core/CHANGELOG.md, dclab_rnd/kinds/capability.json.

findings.defect: The gateway text encoder sent workspace texts through a purpose that may never see them.
findings.scenario: Support-ticket texts would go to the embedding purpose, whose limit is the evidence records with no cell values.
findings.fix: The encoder is removed; a purpose with its own data limit is the owner's decision.
findings.impact: User data would have reached a model the Admin page says never sees it.

findings.defect: The cache keyed items by their printed form.
findings.scenario: 20 different PIL images encoded into one cache gave 18 served from the cache; a replaced file kept its stale vector.
findings.fix: Values for arrays and images, bytes for files, a type tag, and a refusal for anything else.

findings.defect: The image near-copy threshold flagged different scenes and the acceptance failed on two seeds.
findings.scenario: At 0.99, 32 to 135 pairs of different scenes with the same shape were flagged; seeds 2 and 3 failed.
findings.cause: A fixed threshold for an encoder it was not set for.
findings.fix: A threshold calibrated per encoder; the acceptance run on several seeds.

findings.defect: A copied text could stay with its own author, and the text threshold flagged a non-copy.
findings.scenario: Seed 0 pasted ticket 44 again for the same author; a pair at 0.905 that was not a copy was flagged.
findings.cause: The other author was drawn from all authors; the threshold was loose.
findings.fix: Another author always; the calibrated threshold; every copy found and nothing else required; a caveat when copies straddle the holdout.

findings.defect: Tests could not catch a model fitted on the holdout or random folds called grouped.
findings.scenario: Both faults kept the tests and the acceptance green.
findings.cause: Nothing compared what the model saw.
findings.fix: The holdout's predictions are kept and must not move when the holdout's labels change; grouped folds must score below random ones.

findings.defect: A check passed by construction and the open items were hidden.
findings.scenario: solve always used the baselines, so 'the encoder is a baseline' always held; the matrix listed only the engine.
findings.cause: The check described the run instead of the goal.
findings.fix: The check asks for a pretrained encoder measured, fails, and appears in missing.

findings.defect: Briefs mentioning photos were detected as this kind.
findings.scenario: 'Forecast daily demand per store; we also have photos of the shelves' became embedded and set the vision pack.
findings.cause: Bare words and an equal specificity.
findings.fix: A lower specificity and words that need the items to be the input.

findings.defect: Cache names and writes could mix encoders.
findings.scenario: Two weight files named weights.pt shared vectors; two writers shared one temp file.
findings.cause: A file stem as the name; a fixed temp name.
findings.fix: The weights' hash and the size in the name; a temp file per writer; widths checked.

findings.defect: The image encoder did not scale 0-255 photos.
findings.scenario: uint8 photos were normalised as if they were 0-1.

outcome: Built as a library with baseline encoders: 5 of 6 decisions on five seeds; the pretrained encoder is the listed open item.
lessons: A data limit belongs to a purpose: reusing a purpose for other data breaks its promise.
Key a cache by content, never by a printed form.
Calibrate a similarity threshold to the encoder that produced the vectors.
A check that describes what the run did instead of what was asked passes by construction.
risks: User texts sent to a purpose that may not see them.
Different items served one cached vector.
Near copies across the split inflating scores.
